originalTitle: Dropbox (DBX) Stock Drops Despite Market Gains: Important Facts to Note
summary: In the latest trading session, Dropbox (DBX) closed at $36.48, marking a -3% move from the previous day.
content:
Dropbox (DBX) ended the recent trading session at $36.48, demonstrating a -3% change from the preceding day's closing price. This change lagged the S&P 500's 0.17% gain on the day. Meanwhile, the Dow lost 0.18%, and the Nasdaq, a tech-heavy index, added 0.4%.

Heading into today, shares of the online file-sharing company had gained 10.62% over the past month, outpacing the Computer and Technology sector's gain of 0.37% and the S&P 500's loss of 1.29%.

The investment community will be paying close attention to the earnings performance of Dropbox in its upcoming release. The company's upcoming EPS is projected at $0.73, signifying a 1.35% drop compared to the same quarter of the previous year. Our most recent consensus estimate is calling for quarterly revenue of $628.6 million, down 0.92% from the year-ago period.

For the full year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates are projecting earnings of $3.04 per share and revenue of $2.52 billion, which would represent changes of +7.04% and -0.1%, respectively, from the prior year.

It's also important for investors to be aware of any recent modifications to analyst estimates for Dropbox. These revisions typically reflect the latest short-term business trends, which can change frequently. Consequently, upward revisions in estimates express analysts' positivity towards the business operations and its ability to generate profits.

Our research shows that these estimate changes are directly correlated with near-term stock prices. Investors can capitalize on this by using the Zacks Rank. This model considers these estimate changes and provides a simple, actionable rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, which ranges from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), has an impressive outside-audited track record of outperformance, with #1 stocks generating an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Over the last 30 days, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has moved 0.43% higher. Dropbox is holding a Zacks Rank of #5 (Strong Sell) right now.

Valuation is also important, so investors should note that Dropbox has a Forward P/E ratio of 12.36 right now. This signifies a discount in comparison to the average Forward P/E of 15.76 for its industry.

Meanwhile, DBX's PEG ratio is currently 3.52. This popular metric is similar to the widely-known P/E ratio, with the difference being that the PEG ratio also takes into account the company's expected earnings growth rate. As of the close of trade yesterday, the Internet - Services industry held an average PEG ratio of 1.51.

The Internet - Services industry is part of the Computer and Technology sector. Currently, this industry holds a Zacks Industry Rank of 187, positioning it in the bottom 24% of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank gauges the strength of our industry groups by measuring the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks within the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

Keep in mind to rely on Zacks.com to watch all these stock-impacting metrics, and more, in the succeeding trading sessions.

chineseTitle: 尽管市场上涨，Dropbox（DBX）股价仍下跌：需要注意的重要事实
chineseSummary: 在最新的交易日中，Dropbox (DBX) 收于 36.48 美元，较前一日上涨 -3%。
chineseContent:
Dropbox (DBX) 最近交易日收盘价为 36.48 美元，较前一天收盘价上涨 -3%。这一变化落后于标准普尔 500 指数当日 0.17% 的涨幅。与此同时，道指下跌 0.18%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 0.4%。

截至今天，这家在线文件共享公司的股价在过去一个月上涨了 10.62%，超过了计算机和技术板块 0.37% 的涨幅以及标准普尔 500 指数 1.29% 的跌幅。

投资界将密切关注Dropbox即将发布的产品的盈利表现。该公司即将公布的每股收益预计为0.73美元，较去年同期下降1.35%。我们最新的一致预测是季度收入为 6.286 亿美元，比去年同期下降 0.92%。

对于全年，Zacks 一致预期预计每股收益为 3.04 美元，收入为 25.2 亿美元，与上一年相比分别变化 +7.04% 和 -0.1%。

对于投资者来说，了解 Dropbox 分析师预测的最新修改也很重要。这些修订通常反映最新的短期业务趋势，这些趋势可能经常变化。因此，预估的上调表明了分析师对业务运营及其产生利润的能力的积极态度。

我们的研究表明，这些估计变化与近期股价直接相关。投资者可以通过使用 Zacks Rank 来利用这一点。该模型考虑了这些估计变化并提供了一个简单、可操作的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统的范围从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），具有令人印象深刻的外部审计表现优异记录，自 1988 年以来#1 股票的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去 30 天里，Zacks 共识每股收益估计上升了 0.43%。 Dropbox 目前的 Zacks 排名为#5（强劲销售）。

估值也很重要，因此投资者应该注意 Dropbox 目前的远期市盈率为 12.36。与该行业 15.76 的平均远期市盈率相比，这意味着存在折扣。

与此同时，DBX 的 PEG 比率目前为 3.52。这个流行的指标与广为人知的市盈率类似，不同之处在于，PEG比率还考虑了公司的预期盈利增长率。截至昨天收盘，互联网-服务业的平均PEG比率为1.51。

互联网服务行业是计算机和技术行业的一部分。目前，该行业的 Zacks 行业排名为 187，在所有 250 多个行业中排名垫底 24%。

Zacks 行业排名通过衡量行业组内个股的平均 Zacks 排名来衡量我们行业组的实力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
